metadata.description: Binding DECISIONS.md design-memory enforcement for Claude Code.

plugins.name: decisions-md
plugins.description: Binding design memory for a project's DECISIONS.md. Serves the decisions that govern a file just before Claude edits it, carries them through compaction, lints the file for format and bloat, and asks about capture only for work no decision covers. Standard library only; keeps its state out of your repository.
